title: aspidium subdigitatum
intro: Aspidium subdigitatum, commonly known as Polypodium subdigitatum, is a species of epiphytic fern native to tropical Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium subdigitatum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, making it useful in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
